model_annotation: Figure 4 presents the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The pie chart displays four slices representing different ambiguity std (outer) and max ambiguity (inner) categories. The slice labeled “Max: 1” is colored light green and occupies approximately 47.7% of the chart. The slice labeled “Max: 2” is colored light blue and constitutes around 38.6% of the total area. A smaller slice, designated "Max: 3”, is colored yellow and represents approximately 7.4% of the pie. Finally, the smallest slice, labeled “Max: 0”, is colored dark green and accounts for roughly 6.3% of the chart. The chart includes a legend identifying each slice by its ambiguity category, and percentage labels are provided inside each slice. The slices appear ordered clockwise, broadly corresponding to descending size, starting with "Max: 1" at the top.
